descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT OAT-05 step 6; TFA-92568 AC 7, AC 11 · “Confirm the subprocessor list and hosting arrangement are documented.”.

Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S07 Provider report and subprocessor list: every vendor the code can reach, with account, region and hosting, documented, dated and owned

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T4 Engineering reports which providers and services are actually in use, and under which account and hosting setup, so this can be checked against what the BAAs cover. (TFA-92568 AC 7; TFA-92568 Eng 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress
  • U6 The subprocessor list and the hosting arrangement are documented and kept current as a record. (UAT OAT-05; TFA-92568 AC 11; TFA-92568 Product 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given The code at the UAT commit, the production config (aiProvider row, Convex env names, Pulumi stack outputs), the documented subprocessor list and hosting arrangement (location per Q11), and the consent screen list

When Tim and Quinn write the provider report: for each provider and service, what data it receives, from which function, and under which account, org or project, and region. Then compare the documented subprocessor list with the report entry by entry, and check that it is dated, names an owner and states the hosting arrang …

Then The report lists at least: Convex (backend and hosting); AWS Bedrock Claude Haiku 4.5 and Mistral Large 3 (account, region, guardrail); OpenAI gpt-live-transcribe and whisper-1, and OpenAI text only if the row can select it (org); Google Vertex Gemini (project, location); AWS SES (sign-in code, no PHI). …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-92568 AC 7 and Eng 6; UAT OAT-05 step 6 and TFA-92568 AC 11 and Product 4. A vendor or service the code can send data to that the report leaves out, or a vendor without its account or project, is a Fail. A missing list, a reported vendor missing from the list, or no date or owner is a Fail. …

Where it ran: local code-review (judged by reading the code); test method DOC · Document check; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-05.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane code-review.

Test method: DOC · Document check; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: code-review.
